description: Defines the QuicCryptoServerStreamBase class and related interfaces for QUIC crypto server stream handling, including methods for managing TLS handshake, resumption, and server configuration updates.
external_methods: QUIC_EXPORT_PRIVATE std::unique_ptr<QuicCryptoServerStreamBase> CreateCryptoServerStream(const QuicCryptoServerConfig*, QuicCompressedCertsCache*, QuicSession*, QuicCryptoServerStreamBase::Helper*)

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for QUIC crypto server stream handling, providing interfaces for TLS handshake management, resumption, and server configuration.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerStreamBase::Helper
classes.description: Interface for helper functions used by QuicCryptoServerStreamBase, including client hello acceptance policy.

methods.name: CancelOutstandingCallbacks
methods.description: Cancels any pending asynchronous callbacks, such as client hello validation.

methods.name: GetBase64SHA256ClientChannelID
methods.description: Retrieves the base64-encoded SHA-256 hash of the client's ChannelID key if presented.

methods.name: NumServerConfigUpdateMessagesSent
methods.description: Returns the number of server config update messages sent.

methods.name: SendServerConfigUpdate
methods.description: Sends the latest server configuration and source-address token to the client.

methods.name: DisableResumption
methods.description: Disables TLS resumption if possible, returning true if disabled.

methods.name: IsZeroRtt
methods.description: Checks if the connection was a successful 0-RTT resumption.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Checks if the connection was established via a resumption handshake.

methods.name: ResumptionAttempted
methods.description: Indicates whether the client attempted a resumption handshake.

methods.name: EarlyDataAttempted
methods.description: Indicates whether the client attempted to use early data.

methods.name: ShouldSendExpectCTHeader
methods.description: Determines if the Expect-CT header should be sent.

methods.name: DidCertMatchSni
methods.description: Checks if a certificate matching the SNI hostname was selected.

methods.name: ProofSourceDetails
methods.description: Returns details from the latest proof source call, if available.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterial
methods.description: Method for exporting keying material, not implemented here.
